host.title: Host name
host.description: Host name for the WebUI, like 'qbittorrent.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

downloads_dir.title: Downloads directory
downloads_dir.description: Absolute path of an existing host directory to bind-mount as the downloads directory. Leave empty to use the qbittorrent-downloads named volume, which can be moved to an additional disk from the cluster UI. The directory must be writable by the module user.

bt_port.title: BitTorrent listen port
bt_port.description: TCP/UDP port used for incoming peer connections. Forward this port on the upstream router to get incoming connections.

bt_port_enabled.title: Open the BitTorrent port in the firewall
bt_port_enabled.description: Allow incoming peer connections from the public firewall zone. Disable it when the port is published some other way, for instance through a VPN.

umask.title: File creation mask
umask.description: Umask applied to downloaded files, as an octal value like '002'.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone used inside the container, like 'Europe/Budapest'.

auth_whitelist.title: Trusted networks
auth_whitelist.description: Comma separated list of subnets in CIDR notation whose clients reach the WebUI without a password, for instance '192.168.0.0/24'. Leave empty to always require authentication. Because Traefik forwards every request from 127.0.0.1, the module also turns on qBittorrent's reverse proxy support so the list is matched against the real client address.
